facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; service exports don't have to go through the official FX market.
facts.P2_fcy_account: No: dollar accounts in Colombia aren't allowed, but accounts abroad are.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Wompi accepts individuals on their RUT or cédula with a Bancolombia or Nequi account.
facts.L1_registration: Register in the RUT with DIAN, free online with your cédula.
facts.L2_tax_id: NIT, assigned when you register in the RUT.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 0–39%; Régimen Simple starts at 5.9% for services.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 19% IVA; services used only abroad are exempt; below 3,500 UVT, no IVA duties.
facts.L5_data_protection: Ley 1581 applies; individuals and small firms needn't register databases.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can withdraw within 5 business days of delivery (retracto).
facts.L7_incentives: Régimen Simple at 5.9%, IVA exemption on exports, and no IVA under 3,500 UVT.

watch_out.text: Wompi pays individuals their first payout 30 days after the first sale.
The export IVA exemption needs a client with no business in Colombia.
